packs.title: Packs Management
packs.description: Review free-delivery packs, and create or manage any store's packs
packs.showing_oldest: Showing the oldest {shown} of {total} — decide these to see the rest.

detail.unsellable_review: Customers can't see this pack until every item is from this store, available, approved and has a whole-number quantity — approving it won't change that. See the items flagged above.
detail.unsellable_active: Customers can't see this pack until every item is from this store, available, approved and has a whole-number quantity. See the items flagged above.
detail.unsellable_empty: This pack has no items, so customers can't see it.
detail.free_delivery_hint: Approving lets this pack go live with free delivery. The merchant covers the delivery fee.

decision.note_hint_review: Only sent if you reject — required then, and shown to the merchant. Approving ignores it.
decision.note_required: Add a note so the merchant knows why.
decision.reject_placeholder: e.g. The discount and free delivery together sell this pack below cost…
decision.deactivate_placeholder: e.g. This pack contains an item that is no longer allowed…

errors.network: Couldn't reach Blink Server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.forbidden: Your staff role isn't allowed to manage packs.
errors.not_found: This pack no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
errors.invalid: Blink Server refused this decision. Rejecting or deactivating needs a reason. ({detail})
errors.conflict: This pack changed or was already decided since you opened it (or it can't change from its current status). The list has been refreshed — reopen it to see the latest version.
errors.throttled: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

empty.review: No packs waiting for review. All caught up!

manage.title: Manage
manage.archive_body: Customers stop seeing “{name}” right away. It stays in the merchant's archived packs, and you can activate it again later.
manage.delete_body: “{name}” is removed for good, for the merchant too. Past orders keep their copy of it, and the merchant is notified. This can't be undone.
manage.conflict: This pack changed since you opened it, so nothing was done. The list has been refreshed — open the pack again to see the latest version.

editor.new_subtitle: Bundle products of one store. Packs made by Blink skip review, and the merchant is notified.
editor.edit_subtitle: Changes apply as soon as you save, and the merchant is notified.

store.title: Store
store.description: A pack holds products of one store only.
store.more: Showing {shown} of {total} — refine the search to see the rest.
store.change_clears: Picking another store removes the items you added.
store.not_live: This store isn't live, so customers won't see its packs until it is.

items.title: Items
items.description: 1 to 30 products of this store, each with a quantity. Buy X Get Y adds free units on top.
items.pick_store: Pick a store to start adding products.
items.empty: No items yet — add products from the list below.
items.no_products: This store has no products yet.
items.more: Showing {shown} of {total} — refine the search to see the rest.
items.limit_reached: A pack holds up to 30 products.

details.title: Details
details.name: Name
details.description_ph: What's inside and why it's a good deal (optional)
details.image_hint: Optional — without a photo, the app shows a collage of the products' photos.
details.image_rules: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB.

offer.title: Offer
offer.discount_hint: Taken off the items' total, from 0 to 90%.
offer.free_delivery_hint: The merchant covers the store's {fee} delivery fee on orders of this pack.
offer.free_delivery_pick_store: The merchant covers the store's delivery fee on orders of this pack.

status.title: Status
status.hint_active: Live: customers can order it once it's saved.
status.hint_inactive: Switched off: saved, but customers don't see it.
status.hint_archived: Archived: hidden from customers and kept in the merchant's archive.
status.hint_under_review: Left as is, the pack stays in the review queue. Pick a status to settle it here.

summary.title: Summary
summary.empty: Add products to see the price.
summary.unsellable: Customers won't see this pack until every item is available and approved — see the flagged items.

validation.image_invalid: The photo link isn't a valid web address.
validation.items_too_many: A pack holds up to 30 products.
validation.items_duplicate: Each product can only appear once.
validation.items_invalid: One of the items isn't a valid product.
validation.items_not_in_store: Remove the items that are no longer products of this store.
validation.quantity_range: Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 999.
validation.promo_range: Buy and get must be whole numbers from 1 to 999.
validation.discount_range: The discount must be a whole percent from 0 to 90.

errors.network: Couldn't reach Blink Server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.forbidden: Your staff role isn't allowed to create or edit packs.
errors.not_found: This pack no longer exists — it may have been deleted.
errors.store_not_found: That store no longer exists. Pick another one.
errors.conflict: This pack changed since you opened it, so nothing was saved. Reload to get the latest version (your edits here will be lost).
errors.throttled: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.duplicate_items: Each product can only appear once in a pack.
errors.invalid_items: Some items aren't products of this store anymore. Remove them and try again.
errors.empty: Nothing to save — no field changed.
errors.validation: Some fields need fixing — see the highlighted ones.
errors.image_type: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
